plugins.name: tagout
plugins.description: The gate-verified GitHub issue → pull request lifecycle for coding agents: create-issue, implement-issue, merge-pr, auto-dev, triage-backlog and their guards. No bundled MCP server, no .NET prerequisite. Add tagout-migrate for a legacy .NET application.

plugins.name: tagout-migrate
plugins.description: The gate-verified seven-phase pipeline that takes a legacy .NET application to verified production, powered by RoselineMCP (Roslyn). Ships the roseline Read gate and the roseline + adr MCP servers (dnx, .NET 10 SDK). Install beside tagout.

plugins.name: ai-migration-kit
plugins.description: Transition entry for installs made before the rename to tagout (#611, #618): the whole kit under its old name, from the root's transition manifest, so `ai-migration-kit@ai-migration-kit-marketplace` keeps loading. Reinstall as tagout@tagout-marketplace (+ tagout-migrate for .NET); this entry and the root manifest go away with the 3.0.0 release (#610).
